newsitem.title: USA: TransPro consolidation cost about $5.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: TransPro consolidation cost about $5.5 mln.

text.p: TransPro Inc said Friday that one time costs of various consolidation actions are expected to be about $5.5 million on a pre-tax basis.

The company said the costs are expected to be incurred throughout 1996 and in the first part of 1997. Once completed, the ongoing annual pre-tax cost benefit of these actions is expected to exceed $5.0 million, the company said.
TransPro recorded $549,000 in pretax plant and business consolidation costs in the third quarter of 1996.

The company said the costs relate to previously announced actions to consolidate the OEM and Aftermarket Heat Transfer organizations in order to increase competitiveness and profitability; to close the New Haven OEM Heat Transfer plant and to move all such manufacturing to Jackson, Miss.; and to relocate an Aftermarket Heat Transfer manufacturing facility from Peru, Ill. to Mexico.
